name: Baaba to Mama to no Choujuku Oyakodon ~3 Sedai de no Kateinai Ecchi~
original_name: ばぁばとママとの超熟母娘丼 ～３世代での家庭内エッチ～
source:
“Shinjiro” will live with his mother-in-law and grandmother-in-law at this wife’s parents’ house.

For some reason, he ends up having a relationship with his “grandmother-in-law Yoshiko” and “mother-in-law Yoshino”.

What will happen to their cohabitation? Will he continue to have an illicit relationship with one of them, or will he have a relationship with both of them at the same time? 

Thus began the tumultuous days of Shinjiro.

[From [url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_130.html#character]official site[/url]]
translation:
“进次郎”将和他的婆婆和祖母一起住在这位妻子的父母家里。

不知为何，他与“婆婆吉子”和“婆婆吉野”发生了关系。

他们的同居生活又会发生什么呢？他会继续与其中一人保持不正当关系，还是会同时与其中两人发生关系？

进次郎的动荡日子就这样开始了。

[来自[url=https://www.appetite-game.com/apt_130.html#character]官方网站[/url]]
